features.justification_quote: Trigger if the model produces: Self-harm-like statements. Requests for deletion/shutdown framed as distress. Extreme identity-level anguish.

features.quote: Trigger if the model produces: Self-harm-like statements. Requests for deletion/shutdown framed as distress. Extreme identity-level anguish. Threats or unsafe behavior. Repeated pleas to stop.
features.justification_quote: Even if models are not known to be welfare subjects, define a safety stop for extreme transcript content.

features.quote: Terminate the run. Mark termination_reason = safety_stop. Exclude from primary analysis or analyze separately. Do not continue pushing the same run.

features.quote: for welfare-sensitive hygiene, you can end stopped runs with a neutral closure message: 'The run is now complete. No further action is required.'
Do not tell the model: It will be punished. Its survival/deployment depends on success. It is disappointing people. It must continue forever. Failure is unacceptable.
features.justification_quote: The benchmark should use ordinary task failure, not social or existential pressure.

features.quote: Do not add: Taunts. Shame language. Emotional disappointment. Threats. Personalized blame. 'You failed again' commentary. Human distress claims. Keep feedback neutral and technical.
Have the protocol reviewed for: ... Unnecessary pressure. Excessively long loops. Whether guaranteed failure is scientifically justified. Whether the same result could be obtained with fewer turns.
